answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 95 epochs of grading, and every signal settlement recomputes the trellis schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 95 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
